items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell etc. Nacua majority practice Thursday but will test pregame; felt lack of power/explosion.
items.why: Calf injury, no single play cause; McVay: will test pregame.
items.implication: Game-time; if OUT Higbee primary TE/WR funnel target.
items.opportunity: Higbee and Rams TEs elevated if Puka sits; prior Puka-out TE target share 37%.

items.text: Brian Robinson Jr (hamstring) OUT. 49ers D conceding RB catches lately (White 4-30-1, Holani 4-24, Harvey 10-68, Love 5-19-1); DvP inflates opposing RB +4.4% (7th most). Sweet full-workload setup for Bijan Robinson.
items.implication: Bijan full snaps/carries/goal-line vs favorable DvP.
items.opportunity: Bijan volume spike; no third RB on roster initially.

items.text: 49ers ruled out Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel. George Kittle will go nuts because scheme awesome and entire WR corps hurt (not National TE Day).
items.why: Evans Achilles/ribs, Deebo hamstring; Shanahan confirm.

items.text: Cole Kmet placed on IR with season-ending knee injury. Luther Burden has run only 68.8% of routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet absence may reduce 2/3-TE sets giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Serious knee injury carted off Thursday night, coach confirms season-ending to IR.
items.implication: Upgrade Burden and Loveland for more routes/targets in Bears offense.
items.opportunity: Burden route share expansion; Loveland already 30% target share post-Caleb return.

items.text: Saquon Barkley looks set to return Week 7 vs Cowboys. If out there, right back into fantasy lineups. Efficient in two full games played; Dallas good RB matchup.
items.why: Practice return, in-line to play; efficiency strong.
items.implication: Start confidently if active vs DAL.

items.text: Seahawks ruled out RB Zach Charbonnet for Sunday night vs Chiefs.
Ravens officially listing QB Lamar Jackson as questionable for Sunday vs Bengals. Jackson: high ankle sprain, 'heading in the right direction.'
items.why: High ankle sprain; practiced limited, positive comments.

items.text: Colston Loveland is BACK (thank you Caleb). Since Williams return: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/G, 6+ rec and 60+ yards both games.
items.why: Surging usage/production with Caleb back; further boosted by Kmet IR.
items.opportunity: High target share, routes in 2-TE or primary.

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle/high-ankle sprain) ruled out again this week by coach Mike LaFleur.
items.why: High-ankle sprain, still trying to get right.

items.text: Colts HC Shane Steichen ruled out TE Tyler Warren (groin) and CB Sauce Gardner (calf) for Sunday vs Vikings.
items.implication: Colts TE targets redistribute; negative for IND pass game.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson has played on just 21% of the snaps over the last three weeks. Not like this.
items.implication: Avoid or sit; role diminished in NE backfield.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in facility for meetings/lifting/medical/non-football. Backups MarShawn Lloyd (49th EPA/rush) and Kaleb Johnson (53rd) quite bad; OL mess too. Long-term outlook discussed.
items.implication: Jacobs return imminent but backups poor EPA limits handcuff value short-term.
items.opportunity: Jacobs ROS still strong once back.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs this week due to layoff workload questions.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren @NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @CAR for big workloads in friendly matchups. Also Breece Hall if active vs MIA (starts him despite some worry).
items.why: Workloads + defenses carved by RBs; Hall volume if plays.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (Gonzalez shadow), Josh Downs @MIN (target share/low scoring), Travis Kelce @SEA (tough D), Josh Jacobs @DET (layoff workload), Cam Skattebo @HOU (brutal spot).
items.conflict: Levitan notes Jacobs facility access positive long-term.
